title: ADR Frontmatter
description: Frontmatter metadata for an Architecture Decision Record

id.description: Stable ADR identifier (e.g. adr-0001). Must match the filename.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the ADR

date.description: ISO-8601 date when the decision was recorded (YYYY-MM-DD)

deciders.description: People involved in making this decision

items.description: What this decision constrains: a domain item (ordering.OrderPlaced), an actor (actor.Customer), a flow (flow.OrderFulfillment), or a context (context.ordering). Prefix with service: for federated refs.

domain_refs.description: Domain items, actors, flows, or contexts related to this decision

superseded_by.description: ID of the ADR that supersedes this one (optionally service-qualified for peer ADRs)

supersedes.description: ID(s) of the ADR(s) this decision replaces — the forward half of the supersession chain, so 'what did this replace?' is answerable without scanning every ADR

tags.description: Free-form labels for filtering (e.g. security, storage, api)

links.description: External references — ticket, PR, RFC, or design-doc URLs backing this decision

code_refs.description: POSIX glob patterns (repo-relative) binding this decision to the source it constrains (e.g. src/storage/**). Used by `dkk drift --file` to answer 'which decisions govern this file?'.

review_by.description: Date by which this decision should be revisited (YYYY-MM-DD). `dkk adr audit` reports ADRs past it.

^x-.description: Extension namespace — any `x-`-prefixed key passes through untouched, so a team can carry its own metadata without patching the schema
